readStrip: LiSN read 386 partner and installer interactions in the last 7 days, about 77 a working day, across email, help desk, service calls and Salesforce.
brief: Delivery promise slipped for three distributors in {{region:North}}; one issue we fixed in June is back; installers report extra set-up time on network configuration.

7d.title: What's critical
7d.body: {{region:North}}: promise kept 71% against its own 88% this week. 3 distributors, 14 order lines, 2 projects facing a fire NOC inspection.

7d.title: Where's your focus
7d.body: Licence re-activation after a laptop change is back for the third time since the June fix. 11 contacts this week.

7d.title: What's stable
7d.body: Ease of programming praised again this week. {{region:South}} and {{region:West}} promise kept on target.

30d.title: What's critical
30d.body: {{region:North}}: promise kept 77% against its own 88% over 30 days, falling every week. 3 distributors, 46 order lines, 2 projects facing a fire NOC inspection.

30d.title: Where's your focus
30d.body: Licence re-activation is back: 35 contacts in 30 days, 22 of them in the last two weeks.

30d.title: What's stable
30d.body: Ease of programming praised 6 times in 30 days, steady. Same-day replies to partners up to 63%.

90d.title: What's critical
90d.body: {{region:North}} held 87–90% for nine weeks, then fell to 71% in the last four. 52 order lines affected, 2 projects facing a fire NOC inspection.

90d.title: Where's your focus
90d.body: Five fixes did not hold this quarter, led by licence re-activation (64 contacts), order status on the help desk (58) and device addressing (41).

90d.title: What's stable
90d.body: Ease of programming: 22 praise mentions this quarter. Promise kept across all regions up 6 points since August, {{region:North}} the exception.

questionCards.title: Are we keeping our promises?
questionCards.subtitle: Delivery · last-mile · promise dates
questionCards.insight: Most {{region:North}} misses trace to one allocation queue, not supply.

questionCards.title: What keeps coming back?
questionCards.subtitle: Licence · addressing · order desk
questionCards.insight: Three fixes did not hold. Each is linked to what was done last time.

questionCards.title: What do installers experience?
questionCards.subtitle: Network · programming · partner voice
questionCards.insight: Installers describe ~25 extra minutes on network set-up; most first-line feedback sits with partners.

signals.title: {{region:North}} promises slipping
signals.recommendation: Operations lead: confirm dates for the 2 projects with fire NOC inspections; one confirmed date per distributor.

signals.title: {{place:Gurugram}} last-mile delays
signals.recommendation: Operations lead: open a last-mile review for the {{place:Gurugram}} carrier.

signals.title: Licence re-activation is back
signals.recommendation: Technical support lead: update the knowledge article and confirm the portal change with the US product team.

signals.title: Device addressing is back
signals.recommendation: Technical support lead: re-run the addressing training with partners who swapped panels.

signals.title: Network set-up is slower
signals.recommendation: Product liaison: share a one-page set-up guide with partners; send a feedback note to the US product team.

signals.title: Legacy panel upgrades
signals.recommendation: Technical support lead: publish an upgrade path guide for legacy panels still in the field.

signals.title: Order status on wrong desk
signals.recommendation: Technical support lead: refresh the auto-reply with a clearer order-desk path.

signals.title: Two dates for one order
signals.recommendation: Operations lead: one confirmed date per order, shared by sales and support.

signals.title: Delivery worry in deals
signals.recommendation: Sales ops: review {{region:North}} deals noting delivery risk with Operations.

signals.title: {{region:SEA}} promise improving
signals.recommendation: No action needed — keep watching. {{region:SEA}} promise kept is holding at 92%.

signals.title: Programming praise holding
signals.recommendation: Marketing: use the programming praise quote with partners in the next install brief.
